translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Tule Pab-Machigin penzhulil, iti-napkined-pinzheed-igalgin nako
Imi meke-ibi-tule penzhulil, Jesús Pab-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-Cristo, we tule Pabgin purpal mimmiles. Teginbal, meke-ibi-tule Pab-Tummad-pilalel, we tule ampa Pab-Machi-pilalmo.
Tenal anmal Pab-pilalmaladbal, tegin anmal Pab-chogzhad-pallí-nanedimaladbal anmal nued wismaldo, anmal Pab-nuskan-pilalmalmo.
Tenal tule chunchunnad Pab-pilalel, Pab-chogzhad-pallí nanemal. Tenal tule Pab-chogzhad-pallí immal imagal, wedin twagdar peyedzhe ib-tutujul chul, wedin pul lolló.
Tenal meke-ibi-tule Pabgin mimmilesmalal, we tule pato iti-napkined-pinzheed-igalgin nakwemalo. Tenal anmal Jesúsgin-penzhulidbal iti-napkined-pinzheed-igalgin nakwemalmogo.
¿Tede toa-tulemalzhun iti-napkined-pinzheed-igalgin nako? Nabir. Tenal tule Jesúsgin penzhulil Jesús Pab-Machi-chunchunnad, we tulemalbi iti-napkined-pinzheed-igalgin nakwemalo.
Tule-Pab-Jesúsgin-penzhulmalad nued wismal emalde ilagwen-nadguo tullego

Imi tule-tibal-tegin-abebal-nonikid, wedin Jesucristo. Tenal Jesucristo tiginbi kwen nonijul, tenal Jesús abebal nonibal. Tenal Pab Purpa Nued ib-chunchunnadginbi unnila chunma-choggu, al Pab Purpa Nued Jesucristogin chog: “Wedin Pab-Machi.”
Tenal immal-chogpágwad oyonai, Jesucristo Pab-Machi-chunchunnad.
Tenal we immal-chogpágwad, Pab Purpa Nued, tegin ti, tegin abe. Tenal we immal-chogpágwad ampa yopí Jesucristogin chunmananimal.
Tenal anmal tule-chunmakedbal ibzhemal, tenal Pab-Tummad-chunmaked tule-chunmakedga pul chunchunnad-choggu, al anmal pul-pule Pab-Tummad-aga-E-Machigin-chunmakedgin ibzheed-wilubmal.

Tenal meke-ibi-tule Pab-Machigin penzhul-kunonikil, we tule aga ulubgin mag itononiko Jesucristo Pab-Machi-chunchunnad. Tenal meke-ibi-tule Pab-Machigin penel, we tule Pab-Tummad-e-Machigin-chunmajad kwen ibzhejulidbal kakanchiliga Pab-Tummad-imanoni.
¿Imi Pab Tummad, aga e-Machigin igi chunmas pe ebinzhe? Nabir. Imi Pab Tummad chogdo, ede anmalga igal-ukcha ilagwen-nadgu tullegal. Tenal tule-ilagwen-nadgu-tulleged e-Machigin tani.
Tenal tule chunchunnad aga ulubgin Pab-Machi-nikal, we tuledin ilagwen-nadgu-tullego. Tenal tule aga ulubgin Pab-Machi-nikchulil, we tule ilagwen-nadgu pal kwen tullegojul-kuo.
Imi pemal-Pab-Machigin-penzhulmaladga an weob karta nermasdo, pemal nuekwa wisgumalgal pemal ilagwen-nadgu tullego.
Imi anmal nued wismaldo, anmal Pabzhe kolalil, tegin anmal Pab-peigujiidbal immal ekisel, Pab anmal-itogo.
Tenal anmal nued wismal-choggu Pab keg-chulgu anmal-itogo, al anmal nued wismalbaldo, anmal Pabzhe meke-ibi-immala ekisel, anmal-Pabzhe-immal-ekichijadyob Pabdin anmalga immal imako.

Imi pe kwenad-takalil iskuedgin kudii, tenal we iskued tule-mejed-chulil, pedin, pe we kwenadga Pabzhe kolo. Tenal Pab kannan we tule-iskudiid-nudagalbal. Tenal antin iskued-lologanaginbi chunma. Tenal kwen iskued nika, tule-mejed. Tenal pedin melle iskued-tule-mejedga Pabzhe kolmalo.
Tenal tule immal-akalomalad, pel-kwapa iskuedbi. Tenal iskued chogbo nika, kwen tule-mejed tegin kwéntin keg tule-mejed.
Imi anmal nued wismaldo, meke-ibi-tule-Pabgin-mimmilenonikil, keg iskuedgin nane. Tenal Pab-Machi nuekwa we tule-chabogo, tenal nia-sagladin we tule-kwen-onaklik-chaojulbal.
Tenal anmal nued wismalbaldo, anmal Pab-nuskan. Tenal iti-nap-naid-ugakche tule-pukmalad nia-saglaje kalesbukmal.

Tenal anmal nued wismalbaldo, Pab-Machi noni anmal mag immal-itogal. Al anmal mag Pab-Machi-chunchunnad-wisgunonimal. Tenal anmal Pab-Machi-chunchunnadgin mai. Tenal Pab-Machi-chunchunnaddin Jesucristo. Wedin Pab-chunchunnad tegin ilagwen-nadgu-tule-otulogedbal.
Nuskan-pilalmalad, wijirmalo, aga pe nue takermal Pab-Tummaganyob chowal-mimmigan-chobalmaladzhe. Pitomalgu.
